label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

Right, I’m absolutely buzzing about this and can finally let you in on the plan for Gran’s 80th!

Morag’s said I can have Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Rd all to ourselves on Saturday 12 December. She shuts at 12, so we’ve got the place from 1pm for a wee family pamper afternoon before Gran’s birthday dinner. Her birthday’s the Sunday, but we’re starting the celebrations early!

I want to do everyone’s hair for free — my treat. That’s me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran, Ava and Ruby. Seven heads to get sorted, including my own, so I’ll need to be organised for once 😂 Cut and blow-dry for everybody that wants one, and colours too, as long as you let me know in time. Ava and Ruby can have wee braids and glitter spray. They’ll be in their element.

Can you all get back to me with what you fancy having done? **I need to know about any colours by Friday 27 November** so I can order everything from the wholesaler. No last-minute colour requests, please! Linda, at least this time we’ll be in a proper salon, so your cooker and the dog are safe.

Gran said at Easter she’d “love to go silver properly” but wouldn’t pay salon prices, so I’d love to chat to her about that and see what we can do. Don’t breathe a word to her, though — the afternoon’s a surprise!

Mum, can you be in charge of getting her there for 1pm without telling her why? You’re our best bet for coming up with something she’ll believe.

Bring a bottle of fizz along and we’ll make an afternoon of it. Morag’s happy with that as long as we tidy up after ourselves.

Dinner’s booked for **8.30pm that night at the Italian on Byres Rd**, table for nine with Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man joining us. All looking gorgeous for our birthday girl.

Honestly, can’t wait. Just need you lot to tell me what you’re wanting now!

Love yous xx
